queries.sql:
SELECT p.account_code, SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount
      FROM SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.PUBLIC.V_PLAN_COMPOSED p
      WHERE p.version_id = 1 AND p.fiscal_year = 2025
        AND 1=1
        AND 1=1
        AND 1=1
      GROUP BY p.account_code
